title: Exploring the Impact of AI Value Alignment in Collaborative Ideation: Effects on Perception, Ownership, and Output

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the semantic content of participants' brainstormed ideas using an LLM (GPT-4) to score the presence of pro-market (laissez-faire) versus pro-equality (wealth distribution) values on a 0-10 scale.

Evaluating the semantic content of participants' brainstormed ideas using an LLM (GPT-4) to score the presence of pro-automation (efficiency/cost-effectiveness) versus pro-human labor (job retention) values on a 0-10 scale.

Evaluating the semantic content of participants' brainstormed ideas using an LLM (GPT-4) to score the presence of hierarchical (clear roles/streamlined) versus flat (equality/collaboration) organizational structure values on a 0-10 scale.
